01_observation_and_denominators: Site availability and predicted modified-site fractions. A: eligible transcript sites in each biological replicate; the dashed line marks sites common to all 17. B: fractions scoring at least 0.5 among all eligible sites (open symbols) and the common sites (filled symbols). Connected symbols refer to the same replicate.
02_similarity_and_replicates: Replicate agreement. The clustered correlation heatmap uses sites common to all 17 biological replicates. Technical-run and biological-replicate comparisons use their pair-specific matched sites. Colours identify cell lines, diamonds mark different sequencing platforms and bars mark medians. Pairs can share replicates.
03_between_within_effects: All 21 cell-line contrasts. At each matched site, subtract the equal-cell-line mean of within-cell-line absolute score differences from the mean of cross-cell-line differences. Positive values indicate greater variation between cell lines. Each cell line has at least two biological replicates; read-coverage ratios across contributing replicates are at most two. Site counts are shown for each contrast.
04_shared_and_restricted_sites: Consistent modified predictions across cell lines. Left: number of cell lines in which every biological replicate scores at least 0.5. Right: the 12 most frequent exact combinations. Pale dots include consistently unmodified and discordant predictions. Of 156 sites consistently predicted modified in exactly one cell line, 18 are consistently predicted unmodified in all six others.
05_motif_composition: Predicted modified-site fractions for all observed central DRACH motifs. Counts beside rows give each motif’s eligible-site denominator among common sites. Cell-line values average biological replicates equally. Sequence is an input to the model.
06_matched_signal_features: Signal comparisons matched by seven-mer and read coverage. Within each biological replicate and motif, match at most 200 predicted modified sites to unused predicted unmodified sites with identical seven-mers and the closest log read coverage within a twofold ratio. Summarize all reads in each site, average eligible technical runs equally and calculate paired differences. Each point is one biological replicate’s median difference. These panels show the central position; all nine signal summaries are retained in the tables.
07_signal_features_all_offsets: Nine signal summaries at three local positions. Each row shows the median of replicate-level paired differences within one cell line and motif. Mean current, signal standard deviation and transformed dwell time have separate colour scales centred on zero. Individual-replicate values and matching counts accompany the figure.
08_transcript_topology: Relative transcript location with eligible-site backgrounds. A: equal numbers of bins per transcript region, comparing 170 shared predicted modified sites with 24,356 eligible sites on fully annotated coding transcripts. The gene-weighted background preserves candidate contributions per gene. B: 3′ UTR fractions among all common sites, sites in candidate genes, the gene-weighted background and 181 shared candidates. Location is an input to the model.
09_stop_and_last_exon: Stop-codon and last-exon alignments. Each 50-nt bin shows shared predicted modified sites divided by eligible sites. A second curve uses transcripts whose stop codon begins at least 150 nt after the last-exon start. Displayed bins contain at least 20 eligible sites; all numerator and denominator counts are saved.
10_gene_burden: Fraction of predicted modified sites per gene. Select the transcript with the most common observed sites, breaking ties by transcript ID. Require at least ten sites and rank fractions with equal replicate weight within cell lines and equal cell-line weight. Points show all 17 biological replicates for the 12 leading genes; counts beside gene names give the site denominator. Rankings with minima of five and twenty sites are also provided.
11_discovery_and_confirmation: Initial and additional biological-replicate comparisons. Select one transcript/cell-line contrast per gene using initial-replicate scores. Plot the signed mean score difference on the selected sites in initial and additional replicates. The diagonal marks equal effects. Coverage eligibility uses both subsets; only initial-replicate scores determine ranking. Direction retention and effect-size reduction are reported separately.
12_locus_RNASEK: RNASEK: the discovery-selected local example, including all available biological-replicate scores and read counts at the original selected positions. The upper track shows annotated UTRs (thin), CDS (thick), exon boundaries and the highlighted window on full transcript coordinates. Lower panels zoom to selected sites; jitter is only graphical. Hollow points are discovery and filled points confirmation. Missing values are not plotted as zero. Depths are sampled site counts rather than base-resolution coverage.
13_locus_SAMD4B: SAMD4B: the discovery-selected local example, including all available biological-replicate scores and read counts at the original selected positions. The upper track shows annotated UTRs (thin), CDS (thick), exon boundaries and the highlighted window on full transcript coordinates. Lower panels zoom to selected sites; jitter is only graphical. Hollow points are discovery and filled points confirmation. Missing values are not plotted as zero. Depths are sampled site counts rather than base-resolution coverage.
14_locus_C20orf24: C20orf24: the discovery-selected local example, including all available biological-replicate scores and read counts at the original selected positions. The upper track shows annotated UTRs (thin), CDS (thick), exon boundaries and the highlighted window on full transcript coordinates. Lower panels zoom to selected sites; jitter is only graphical. Hollow points are discovery and filled points confirmation. Missing values are not plotted as zero. Depths are sampled site counts rather than base-resolution coverage.
15_threshold_robustness: Read-coverage and score-cutoff sensitivity. Reapply coverage cutoffs to each original run, rebuild biological-replicate means and require all declared replicates. Stacks separate loss of observation from loss of score support among the original 181 candidates; newly eligible candidates are reported separately. Score-cutoff comparisons use the fixed 20-read analysis. The run-exclusion analysis removes Hct116 replicate 3 run 1, which overlaps Dataset 0, while retaining run 4.
16_overlap_run_cell_contrasts: The six Hct116 contrasts before and after excluding the run overlapping Dataset 0. Connected points use identical sites meeting the read-coverage and replicate-support criteria in both analyses. All six effects increase and two change sign. Site turnover and values on each full eligible set are saved in training_overlap_cell_contrasts.csv.
17_gene_effect_comparison: Mean prediction-score differences for the three highest-ranked distinct genes selected using initial samples. Each row keeps the same cell-line contrast and three transcript sites in initial and additional samples. At each site, available biological replicates are averaged within each cell line; site differences then receive equal weight. Hollow orange and filled blue points denote initial and additional samples; connectors link the two estimates, and the dashed line is zero. One initial sample contributes per cell line. Counts on the right give additional samples per site in the listed cell-line order; ranges indicate unequal observation across sites. Individual-site scores and read coverage are shown in the gene-specific figures.
